BundleInfo.name: ChimeraX-FigureStyle
BundleInfo.Author: Lukas W. Bauer (AI-assisted development by Claude, Anthropic)
BundleInfo.Synopsis: Reusable named style templates for publication-ready figures
BundleInfo.Description: FigureStyle lets you define, save, and apply named visual style templates in ChimeraX. Templates store lighting, background, silhouettes, per-type cartoon style, coloring (including AlphaFold pLDDT), and image export settings — set up a look once, then apply it to any structure with one click or from the command line.

Classifiers.ChimeraXClassifier: ChimeraX :: Tool :: FigureStyle :: General :: Reusable named style templates for publication-ready figures
ChimeraX :: Command :: figurestyle apply :: General :: Apply a named style template to the current session
